instruction: How does The Gentle Conquest Chapter 11 The Friendship Gap work?
output: Chapter 11: The Friendship Gap The piece ran under the title "The Friendship Gap," and it was the best work Priya Chakraborty had ever done. She read it one final time from the editorial proof at eleven o'clock on a Tuesday night in her apartment on Capitol Hill—not the loft she'd shared with Meera in Adams Morgan, which she'd moved out of two years ago when the neighborhood got too expensive, but a smaller place, a one-bedroom on the third floor of a brown brick building where the radiator clanked and the windows stuck in winter. She liked it.
